description: We are a team of 12th-grade students from Palu, Central Sulawesi. This is our very first time participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge hackathon! Our team is filled with curious minds, passionate storytellers, visual artists, and dreamers who have a unique talent for interpreting their imagination and turning it into reality. Through this project, we want to prove that geographical boundaries and age are no limits when it comes to creating something meaningful for space exploration.
summary: Our project, "Home Beyond the Stars", is an interactive digital illustrated storytelling platform highlighting the real story of NASA’s Surveyor 3 spacecraft. This project addresses the challenge of space education by presenting space exploration history through imaginative, child-friendly, and accessible visuals. It is important to reintroduce historic missions left behind on the Moon to the younger generation in a creative and engaging way.
details:
Function & How it Works: The project is a digital comic website where users can scroll through a narrative story of the Surveyor 3 mission—from laboratory creation, the 1967 Atlas-Centaur rocket launch, and lunar landing, to its final moments before being visited by the Apollo 12 mission.


Benefits & Impacts: Provides interactive, visual, and entertaining space history education for children and general readers.

Tools & Software Used:

  • Canva
  • ChatGPT
  • Gemini

We combined traditional creativity with modern technology. Our project features original hand-drawn sketches created by our team—with some scenes color-rendered with AI assistance, and a few selected scenes generated using AI tools to complete our digital comic narrative. All AI-assisted visuals are properly labeled with watermarks as required.

Creativity & Considerations: The project combines traditional illustration art with modern digital tools. We carefully considered historical accuracy regarding the Surveyor 3 mission while maintaining visual aesthetics to make space science history feel relatable and emotional for readers.
